Gold Rate Today

Gold Rate Today in Greater Noida — and How Your Payout Is Calculated

The gold rate changes every day with the international market, the rupee–dollar rate and local demand — which is why any honest buyer will quote you the exact selling rate at the counter, or on a call, rather than printing a number on a website that may be stale by tomorrow. As a live market rate gold buyer, our valuation always starts from the rate running at the time of your visit.

📞 For today's exact rate, call or WhatsApp us: +91 99532 11815 — it takes 30 seconds, and testing at the store is free either way.

The Formula Every Buyer Uses

Your payout = Pure-gold weight × Today's live rate per gram, where pure-gold weight = item weight × purity percentage.

Purity Table (BIS Standards)

KaratPurityMeaningCommonly Used For
24K99.9% (999)Pure goldCoins & bars
22K91.6% (916)916 hallmarkMost Indian jewellery
18K75.0% (750)750 hallmarkDiamond jewellery
14K58.5% (585)585 hallmarkLightweight / imported jewellery

A Worked Example (Illustration Only)

Say you bring a 10 gram, 22K gold chain. Pure-gold weight = 10 g × 91.6% = 9.16 grams. Your payout = 9.16 × today's live rate per gram for pure gold. At our counter this exact calculation is shown to you on the XRF screen and the weighing scale — before you decide anything.

Why Two Buyers Quote Different Amounts

  • Purity reading — acid tests estimate; XRF measures. A lower "assumed" purity quietly lowers your payout.
  • Deductions — some buyers cut for "wastage", "melting" or stones without showing you the weight.
  • Which rate — the rate should be today's live market rate, not a rounded-down figure.

Our answer to all three: test live on screen, weigh in front of you, calculate openly. Read how selling gold works here or see the full 4-step process.
